snippet.title: Hidden Cats in Beijing: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore Beijing and discover iconic locations, colorful characters, and plenty of hidden surprises!
Search every corner, find all the Hidden Cats, bring each scene to life with color, unlock bonus levels, and celebrate the Spring Festival in a huge special scene.
Hidden Cats in Beijing is coming soon to PC and consoles.
Wishlist now on Steam!
🐱 Find the cats
🎨 Reveal the colors
🏮 Explore Beijing
🐉 Celebrate the Spring Festival
